data.author: Kongvut Sangkla

data.title: Terrain Tiles on AWS (terrarium encoding, zoom 8)
data.author: Mapzen / Linux Foundation; includes SRTM and GMTED (NASA/USGS), ETOPO1 (NOAA) and other public sources
data.license: Public data; attribution to the underlying sources required (see the dataset's attribution page)

data.title: OTOP Product Champion selection (การคัดเลือกสุดยอดหนึ่งตำบลหนึ่งผลิตภัณฑ์ไทย) and OTOP producer register (ทะเบียนผู้ประกอบการ OTOP)
data.author: Community Development Department (กรมการพัฒนาชุมชน), via data.go.th
data.used_for: Each district's OTOP item: rated products are linked to districts through the producer register, grouped into product types, and the most distinctive type is shown. Only product names, types and star ratings are published; producer names are not.

data.title: Natural Earth 1:10m Physical Vectors: Rivers + lake centerlines, and Lakes + reservoirs
data.author: Natural Earth (naturalearthdata.com)
data.used_for: Rivers and reservoirs in data/rivers.json, painted as water in 2D and on 3D block tops

data.title: Natural Earth 1:50m Admin 0 Countries
data.author: Natural Earth (naturalearthdata.com)
data.used_for: Which blocks outside Thailand are land (neighbouring countries) and which are sea

data.title: OpenStreetMap: roads (tertiary and above), railways and rivers
data.author: © OpenStreetMap contributors, extract by Geofabrik
data.license: ODbL 1.0: data/blocks.json road and water layers are a derived database under the same licence
data.used_for: Roads (dirt path → stone bricks), railways and smaller rivers, rasterised per 0.005° block in data/blocks.json

data.title: GeoNames Thailand gazetteer (populated places)
data.author: GeoNames (geonames.org)
data.used_for: Cities (provincial capitals), towns (district seats) in data/towns.json, villages in each province's subdistricts.json, and the settlement layer in data/blocks.json

notes: Trees and rice paddies are generated for looks; elevation is real but averaged over 550 m blocks.
District items come from OTOP product data; hand-picked landmarks are shown alongside, and terrain is used only where a district has no rated OTOP products.
Province items, pixel sprites and descriptions are original to this project.
Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
